mapper.update: UPDATE nursing_plan SET sort_no = #{sortNo}, plan_name = #{planName}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND update_time = #{oldUpdateTime}
mapper.select: SELECT id, sort_no, plan_name, status, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, remark FROM `nursing_plan` ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, sort_no, plan_name, status, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, remark FROM `nursing_plan` WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, sort_no, plan_name, status, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, remark FROM `nursing_plan` WHERE plan_name = #{planName}
